abstract: A case of primary trabecular carcinoid of the ovary apparently occurring from the foregut element of a mature cystic teratoma was reported. The tumor was found incidentally and resected surgically from a 56-year-old female. The cystic teratoma found in the tumor was composed of only respiratory epithelium except a colliculus which showed a picture of tonsil-like tissue. No thyroid tissue was found. The trabeculae of the tumor cells were longer and wavier near the cystic teratoma, while they were straight and short at the periphery. The tumor cells had argyrophil granules but negative in argentaffin granules. The electronmicroscopy revealed many round neurosecretory granules measuring from 170 to 290 nm in diameter. The histogenesis was also discussed.
abstract_ja: 原発性索状カルチノイドの1例を報告する。本症例は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の前腸由来成分から生じたと考えられた。腫瘍は偶然に発見され、56歳女性から外科的に切除された。腫瘍内の嚢胞性奇形腫は呼吸上皮のみからなり、扁桃様組織を示す小隆起を除き、甲状腺組織は認められなかった。腫瘍細胞の索状構造は奇形腫に近い部分で長く波状であり、周辺部では直線的で短かった。腫瘍細胞は銀親和性顆粒を有したが、銀好性顆粒は陰性であった。電子顕微鏡では直径170〜290nmの多数の円形神経分泌顆粒が認められた。その組織発生についても考察した。
